reference: Percent of the current level's exp bar lost on death, transcribed from L2J Mobius CT 0 Interlude dist/game/data/stats/chars/playerXpPercentLost.xml (PlayerXpPercentLostData.getXpPercent). Key is the character level; a level above the table uses the last row. deathPenaltyChance is Character.ini DeathPenaltyChance (Config.java:1656), the share of deaths that raise Death Penalty by one level. respawnRestoreHp/respawnRestoreMp are Character.ini RespawnRestoreHP/MP as fractions of the maxima (Creature.doRevive, Creature.java:2540-2547).
